analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI slightly decreased from 55.1 to 53.6, still within neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from -196.4659 to 61.3638, maintaining a positive signal. Trading volume ratio at 0.54 compared to the 5-day average indicates contraction, reducing confidence in directional judgment. Current price $64,728.34 is above short-term moving averages (SMA5, SMA20, EMA10, EMA20) but below longer-term ones (SMA100, SMA200, EMA200). Weekly ADX at 31.1 suggests a clear trend, but daily ADX at 11.4 indicates a non-trending phase with potential for shock-like volatility. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
